# confinement

Requested and observed confinement of local test commands. No automatic fallback. A command bound to a protocol's action runs outside Substrate, so a run that would start one is refused CommandUnconfined unless the operator opts out of confinement for those commands explicitly.

`intake.confinement` is one of intake's bounded contexts. [All domains](./index.mdx).

## Types

### `AppliedAperture`

`intake.confinement.AppliedAperture` is a record of three fields:

- `name` — `String`
- `destination` — `String`
- `listen` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent

Seven of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `intake.confinement.AppliedConfinement`, `intake.confinement.ChildExit`, `intake.confinement.ChildOutput`, `intake.confinement.ChildStream`, `intake.confinement.ConfinementProfile`, `intake.confinement.ConfinementRefusal` and `intake.confinement.ConfinementSpec`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
